name: unit-observer-controls
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile && mkdir -p /tmp/lane-i-unit-controls && for f in unit-snapshot.ts profile-archive.ts; do bun build research/lane-i/work-meter/f3/$f --target=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/lane-i-unit-controls/${f%.ts}.mjs; done && cp research/lane-i/work-meter/f3/{unit-control.mjs,unit-observer-worker.mjs,profile-window.mjs} /tmp/lane-i-unit-controls/ && for mode in silent zero-price priced; do node /tmp/lane-i-unit-controls/unit-control.mjs $mode > /tmp/lane-i-unit-controls/$mode.log; done && bun research/lane-i/work-meter/f3/audit-unit-controls.ts /tmp/lane-i-unit-controls
